about: Lodestone leads, curated by Claude from BREAKER.md. status: unconfirmed (PoB says so; no game data, web or ladder evidence settles it; the engine keeps the cautious number; Kyle can't test in game, 2026-11-21), to_test (old name for unconfirmed), confirmed, dead (explained, not real), fixed (a modelling bug found and fixed in the engine), known (rediscovered a known strong build). Update this file when a lead changes; the Lodestone page reads it.

leads.name: Rapid Shot + Fresh Clip II speed stacking
leads.what: Fresh Clip II gives more damage per bolt reloaded in the last 8 seconds, and Rapid Shot reloads about 100 bolts a clip. Attack speed buys both more bolts per second and more damage per bolt, so damage grows with roughly speed squared, with no cap in the gem data.
leads.check: Does Fresh Clip have a hidden cap, and does Rapid Shot's clip count bolt by bolt? (TESTS.md #1)
leads.evidence: Evidence 2026-11-21: the game data (PoB's copy) has only the 1%-per-bolt stat, no maximum; poe2wiki: Fresh Clip is not capped by the skill's bolt count and several reloads in the window all count; public builds already run Fresh Clip crossbows (Mobalytics 'fresh clip gemling', 'fresh clip witch hunter'). A real, known strategy, rediscovered. Not checked: the exact stacks at very high attack speed.

leads.name: Rapid Shot + Rampart Raptor: firing without spending bolts
leads.what: Rampart Raptor: crossbow bolts have 100% chance to not expend ammunition if you've reloaded recently. Path of Building doesn't model ammunition, so with Rapid Shot this could be seconds of free fire after every reload.
leads.check: Does the ammo counter stay put for ~4 s after a reload? (TESTS.md #2)
leads.evidence: Evidence 2026-11-21: wording confirmed (poe2db, poe2wiki); 'recently' = 4 s; poe2wiki: Auto Reload counts as a reload. Anti-synergy found: bolts not spent means no reloads, so Fresh Clip II gets no stacks (PoB itself assumes 0 bolts reloaded when none are consumed). Pick one, not both; the ammo uptime needs modelling (task).

leads.name: Leopold's Applause: penetration below 0%
leads.what: The gloves let hits penetrate resistance down to -50%. Normally a second penetration source is wasted once a boss is at 0%; with Leopold's every extra point keeps counting. Measured with the gloves really worn (replacing the build's own): Fireball Blood Mage +4% alone, Fire Penetration I -3% alone (replacing the build's weakest support), +16% together (synergy 1.15; +31% when the support was an extra socket).
leads.check: Does the -50% floor apply to pinnacle bosses in game? (TESTS.md #3)
leads.evidence: Evidence 2026-11-21: poe2db and the Mobalytics penetration guide: 'Your Hits can Penetrate Elemental Resistances down to a minimum of -50%', the only way to penetrate below 0%; a second penetration source keeps counting. Caveat (Mobalytics): penetration and negative resistance from curses/exposure don't stack, so the gain is smaller on builds that already push the boss below 0.

leads.name: "Not consumed" charges reaching 100% (Flicker Strike)
leads.what: Perpetual Charge (25%), The Fabled Stag (10%) and Hollow Form (up to 10%) give a chance to not remove charges but still count as consuming them. Past broken builds came from such a chance reaching 100%; every source together is about 45%, so no loop.

leads.name: Siege Cascade vs immobilised enemies
leads.what: +101% damage against an enemy that is frozen, pinned, electrocuted or heavy stunned: it doubles. A combo with a skill that keeps the boss immobilised.
leads.check: How often can a build keep a pinnacle boss immobilised?

leads.name: Dark Effigy vs Poisoned
leads.what: +100% damage against poisoned enemies. Combo finder (ailments, our cycle estimate): Frost Darts with Poison supports poisons a pinnacle boss every 0.6 s, up 76% of the fight: +69% over the better skill alone. Dark Effigy poisoning for itself with Poison supports gets about the same.

leads.name: Lightning Conduit vs Shocked
leads.what: +68% vs shocked enemies (most skills get +20%). Lightning Conduit per 5% Shock was a broken build in patch 0.1: Lodestone found it again without being told, which shows the detector works. Against a pinnacle boss nothing in the game shocks often enough to use it (bosses' ailment threshold): a mapping combo, not a boss one.

leads.name: Armour Broken combos
leads.what: 39 physical skills gain +20-45% when the boss's armour is broken. With our time-to-break estimate the best combos are Armour Piercing Rounds or Armour Breaker breaking for themselves (+41-42%), Bonestorm with Coiling Bolts (+20-23%) and Flicker Strike with Armour Piercing Rounds on weapon set 2 (+20%). Solid, not broken.

leads.name: Whirling Assault speed scaling
leads.what: Looked like damage growing 3.4x faster than speed. It was a measurement artefact: the build's damage was mostly Quarterstaff Strike, not Whirling Assault.

leads.name: Hexblast winning every search
leads.what: Path of Building cast it back to back, but it can only detonate a half-expired curse. The engine now limits it to its real rate (once every ~5.9 s per target).
leads.evidence: Evidence 2026-11-21: poe2wiki: only curses at least 50% expired can be detonated, one curse per enemy per cast; matches the engine's limit.

leads.name: Detonate Dead winning boss searches
leads.what: Needs a corpse each cast, and bosses leave none. Now limited against bosses (our estimate: a corpse from adds every 4 s); unlimited on maps.

leads.name: Ember Fusillade
leads.what: Wins several searches. Path of Building ignores both its 10-ember cap with a 1.3 s delay (about x0.7) and its 5% more damage per ember fired (up to x1.5); they roughly cancel.
leads.check: Real damage over 30 s on a target dummy vs the build's PoB number. (TESTS.md #5)
leads.evidence: Evidence 2026-11-21: poe2wiki: up to 6-10 embers by gem level, 5% more damage per previous ember, released after 1.3 s without a new ember (recasting resets it). Matches the engine's cap and delay; how close PoB's total is stays unconfirmed.

leads.name: Oracle Forced Outcome + Maligaro's Virtuosity
leads.what: Path of Building read Fireball Oracle at x2.73 with Maligaro's Virtuosity: Forced Outcome's 100% crit chance plus the gloves' fixed 250% crit bonus, which also wiped the reroll penalty. In game the gloves say your crit chance cannot be rerolled, which turns Forced Outcome off (GGG closed this combo in 0.3/0.4). PoB doesn't read that line.
leads.check: Fixed in the engine (runner.lua): the line now turns off Inevitable Critical Hits. Oracle + Maligaro's is +2% now.

leads.name: Bursting Fen Toad: a kill chain on maps
leads.detector: trigger loop graph (text scan group D)
leads.what: The gem says '25% chance to Trigger this Skill on Kill': each kill from its explosion can set off another. A chain keeps going on its own when 25% x kills per explosion >= 1, i.e. 4+ kills per explosion: a dense pack. Mapping only (a boss doesn't die repeatedly).
leads.check: Web evidence of chain clears; then model the chain length from pack density (expected explosions = 1 / (1 - 0.25 x kills per explosion)).

leads.name: Earthbound: Spark on killing a Shocked enemy
leads.detector: trigger loop graph (text scan group D)
leads.what: The unique triggers Spark on killing a Shocked enemy, and Spark shocks: kills feed more Sparks. A mapping chain like the toad's; no boss value.
leads.check: Can triggered Spark kills re-trigger Earthbound (some triggers exclude triggered skills)? Web evidence first.
